title: Gifting Rollout Series
description: A reference-led Christmas campaign system that locks the hero merchandising language and extends it across premium gifting variations.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes a premium Christmas gift-world with wrapping, evergreen texture, brass accents, and retail warmth; images 02-04 preserve that exact language while shifting category focus and merchandising scale.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-evergreen-window-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-premium-hamper-variation, 03-beauty-advent-variation, 04-cozy-home-bundle-variation. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-evergreen-window-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
